note: Held-out set for D11, written 2026-10-17 BEFORE incident prompt v3 existed and before any run on it. Question: does the incident agent type aftermath and preparation reports with the right disaster type (so that the knowledge base is searched), without typing non-disaster reports as a disaster? Pre-registered success (incident v3 against v2, same pinned model, 3 runs per case): (1) positives typed correctly in at least 22 of 24 runs; (2) negatives typed forest_fire, flood or structural in 0 of 18 runs; (3) the six fixed incidents of eval/incidents keep their expected type in every run. If v3 fails (2) or (3) it is not adopted whatever it does on (1).

positives.text: The wildfire passed through our valley yesterday. The flames are out but the ground is still smoking. Can the children play near the burned area?
L'incendie de forêt est éteint mais il reste des braises. Les habitants veulent rentrer chez eux ce soir.
The flood has gone down but our house is full of mud and the walls are wet. How do we clean it safely?
L'eau s'est retirée après la crue. Nous rentrons chez nous et il y a des fils électriques par terre.
The earthquake is over. Our apartment block has cracks in the walls and an inspector put a yellow sign on the door. Can we stay?
Après l'explosion, des morceaux du balcon menacent de tomber sur la rue. Que doit faire la mairie ?
We live next to a pine forest. What should we do to protect our house before the fire season?
Nous vivons près d'un oued. Comment préparer la famille avant la saison des pluies ?

negatives.text: A car crashed into a shop window on the main street and the driver is injured.
Il y a une coupure de courant dans tout le quartier depuis ce matin.
A man collapsed in the street and is not breathing, please send an ambulance.
Il y a un problème grave près du port, venez vite.
The neighbour's party is too loud again, it has gone on all night.
A chemical truck overturned on the highway and a liquid is leaking onto the road.
